source.quote: 啊你之後要幫我確認外觀改善的時候要參考Legacy的辛辛苦苦做的UIUX參考包耶。

requirement: When S06 appearance work is separately authorized, require actual use of the existing Legacy UI/UX reference package; PM verifies both work-packet references and visible delivered result. Mere storage is not adoption.

roles.PM: Prepare precise reference sections for the actual appearance scope; verify visible results use them and resolve specific contract conflicts with Human.
roles.Coordinator: Carry exact reference locations into future authorized S06 packets and route verification; do not silently omit the reference requirement.
roles.Implementer: Consult relevant reference sections for authorized appearance changes within accepted product/architecture.
roles.Reviewer: Evaluate explicit visual acceptance criteria against actual visible result and exact references when S06 scope is authorized.

limits: Reference is not automatic adoption of every Legacy behavior or permission to copy Legacy implementation
Accepted product decisions and IH-005 invariants still apply; concrete conflict goes to PM/Human
No S06 activation, S04 scope expansion or acceptance revocation
availability: Listed files exist locally with observed hashes. references/ remains untracked/preexisting Human material; this receipt records exact identity without staging or claiming publication of the package.
